verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail documents a built-in Email Assistant and Ask AI. The assistant automatically labels mail, archives low-priority messages, drafts replies with inbox, calendar and web context, and reminds you to follow up. Ask AI answers inbox questions and supports follow-up questions in a conversation. Prompt-driven delegation of arbitrary multi-step tasks (for example, 'draft all the nudges and send') is documented mainly through external assistants via MCP, not a native in-app assistant. The chat-built proactive agents appear on a general what's-new page and are not clearly tied to Mail. Missing for 10: documented in-app conversational task delegation beyond Q&A and preset automations, clear Mail-specific scope for chat-built agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Get an email assistant that automatically labels incoming emails, archives low-priority messages, drafts replies, and reminds you to follow up.
Email Assistant works inside Gmail or Outlook to sort incoming messages, draft replies in your voice, clear the noise, and remind you to follow up.
Just ask: _"where is the q2 offsite"_, _"when is my flight"_, _"where am I staying"_, and we'll immediately generate succinct answers.
You can ask follow-up questions in a conversation.
Each draft can use your inbox, calendar, and the web to write replies that are ready to send.
Use chat or our visual builder to create agents that run proactively based on triggers you set and the work you connect.
